title: Fix SPT initialization assume
base_method: Use the selected PR #99 problem snapshot and its immutable direct historical parent. The problem snapshot is also the PR #98 merged squash and is tree-identical to the PR #98 branch head; this truthful eight-path comparison contains both labeled files, while the PR #99 official commit is retained strictly as repair evidence.
source_scope: Complete ostd/ when present at each historical commit, changed files outside ostd/, and root license/notice files. Changed submodules are expanded at their pinned commits.

verification.snapshot_selection: Selected immutable problem 08de0794bf8f1c30a655492ba1092e23a43592ef and direct historical parent 019543e223988c5a436e3f41e958ddbdb763d726; PR #99 official commit bc92f16a61bb069bba8254c9b2cf79aeac6e9cab is repair evidence only.
verification.zero_issues_meaning: Not applicable; this case contains one independently adjudicated semantic initialization/model issue.
verification.source_export: Regenerate the full-index binary diff for 019543e223988c5a436e3f41e958ddbdb763d726..08de0794bf8f1c30a655492ba1092e23a43592ef and byte-check every manifest entry against fixed Git blobs. No additional context is exported.
verification.tool_result: Two independent reviewers approved one semantic initialization/model root. The problem snapshot initializes a state-machine root frame but leaves executable permissions empty, mixes frame-index and physical-address interpretations in the invariant, and trusts the resulting wf predicate. Repair bc92f16a normalizes Paddr keys, inserts the allocated resource, and replaces assume(wf) with assert(wf); its allocator contract adjustment supplies supporting address-validity evidence rather than a second root. Historical Rust/Verus was not executed.
